card.name: The start of words beginning imp-
card.fires_on: The piece 'imp' (or 'Imp') that begins a longer word such as impetus, implications, impelled, imparts or impressed. It is strongest when the word continues in the next piece.

modes.label: Impetus and impel
modes.description: The imp piece starts impetus, impelled or impatience after words like adding, giving or urged by.
